title: Karbala Hogayi  Tayaar khuda khair kare
body:
Khair Karey
<<MINI>>
Khuda Khair Karey
<<DIVIDER>>
Us taraf zulm Pey aamaada zamaaney waaley
Is taraf saarey Mohammad ke gharaaney waaley
Kaun kiska hai tarafdaar khuda Khair Karey
<<MINI>>
Karbala hogayi tayyaar khuda Khair Karey
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye qayaamat ke hai aasaar khuda Khair Karey
<<MINI>>
Karbala hogayi tayyaar khuda Khair Karey
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Roz e aashoor hawaao'n se barastaa hai lahoo
Lutgayi kiski ye Sardaar khuda Khair Karey
2) ye to Mumkin hi nahi hai ke jhukaadey sarr Ko
Kya Karey saahib e kirdaar
<<MINI>>
khuda Khair Karey
<<DIVIDER>>
3) bhai jaatey khuda haafiz o naasir kehkar
Behney kehtii hai ye har Baar khuda Khair Karey
4) wo jo ghodey se giraa saath girey Mashk o alam
Naa Alam hai Naa alamdaar khuda Khair Karey
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Kitney sadmey hai jo sajjad Ko sehney hai Abhi
Beydiyaa'n Hoti hai tayyaar khuda Khair Karey
6) Aaj bhi seeno'n Mey zindaa hai Husain ibney Ali
<<MINI>>
Saara aalam hai Azadar khuda Khair Karey
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Aaney waaley yuhi Aatey rahey rozo'n Pey sadaa
Kamm na ho aapke zawwaar khuda Khair Karey
8) sheh ke maatam Mey hilaal aisi fizaa goonj uthi Kyu ye Larzaa Darr o deewaar
<<MINI>>
khuda Khair Karey
